posts.author: Muta
posts.body:
I have custom walking and running sprites.
What is the best way to approach putting these in?
I use RPG Maker MZ.
I have Galv's plug-ins as well as Visustella stuff.
I can't seem to find a good explanation of switching to custom running sprites.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from General Discussion to Resource Support.

posts.author: Caz
posts.body:
How many frames are your walking/running sprites? If they're using the standard 3 frames,
take a look here at VisuStella's Event & Movement Core VS8 directional sprites
. You can just disable the 8-directional movement if you're only using 4, and your sprites will automatically swap to running when holding dash.

Click to expand...
Depends entirely on what works best for your game. I'd recommend backing up your project somewhere safe and testing both of them out. If you're already using VisuStella Core Engine, it probably makes more sense to just use VS Events & Movement Core. Galv's stuff is great too though so it's up to your preference!
